name: AI Platform Security

fee.note: USD, excluding applicable sales tax. A retake is US$899, a 45-day extension US$479 and a practice exam US$399.

exam.format: One proctored web-based exam: 54 questions in 2 hours, remotely through ProctorU or at a Pearson VUE test centre, with CyberLive hands-on testing. The attempt must be completed within 120 days of activation.

scope: GenAI applications, agentic integrations, architecture, retrieval, model customization and development/deployment security.
ai_policy: Confirm GIAC's current allowed-resource rules; do not infer AI permission from the AI subject.
caveats: The 65% passing score applies to exam versions released on or after 25 July 2026; GIAC says to confirm the format and passing score for your attempt in your GIAC account.
Renewal every four years: 36 CPE credits or a retake, plus the US$499 renewal fee.

access.retake: After a failed attempt wait 30 days; a retake costs US$899 and can be bought until 30 days after the attempt deadline. After three failed attempts, wait one year.
